name: MonarchCommentThread
title: CommentThread
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column with MonarchMessageRow for each comment, MonarchMessageComposer (Foundation BasicTextField with TextFieldState) for the reply field, MonarchButton, MonarchBadge and androidx.compose.material3.AlertDialog for the delete confirmation
summary: One threaded discussion shown in place: an optional quote, the starting comment, replies with older ones folded, Resolve and Reopen, and a reply field that stays busy while saving.
whenToUse: For a discussion anchored to one thing, shown next to it: a comment on a document passage, a field or a ticket, in a sheet or under the item. Use resolved for review flows where threads are settled.
whenNotToUse: For a chat-style conversation, use MonarchVirtualMessageList with MonarchMessageRow and MonarchMessageComposer. For one message alone, use MonarchMessageRow. For a feed of events, use MonarchActivityTimeline.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchCommentThread(comments: List<MonarchCommentThreadComment>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, quote: String? = null, resolved: Boolean = false, visibleReplies: Int = 3, now: Long? = null, replyState: TextFieldState = rememberTextFieldState(), labels: MonarchCommentThreadLabels = MonarchCommentThreadLabels(), onResolvedChange: (suspend (Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, onReply: (suspend (String) -> Unit)? = null, onDeleteComment: (suspend (String) -> Unit)? = null, resolveIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)
class MonarchCommentThreadComment(id: String, author: String, body: String, createdAt: Long, authorImage: Painter? = null, authorSeed: String? = null, canDelete: Boolean = false)

class MonarchCommentThreadLabels(label: ((author: String) -> String)? = null, quote: ((quote: String) -> String)? = null, showEarlier: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, reply: String? = null, replyPlaceholder: String? = null, send: String? = null, resolve: String? = null, reopen: String? = null, resolved: String? = null, resolvedHint: String? = null, resolvedNotice: String? = null, reopenedNotice: String? = null, sentNotice: String? = null, actionFailed: String? = null, deleteComment: String? = null, deleteTitle: String? = null, deleteDescription: String? = null, deleteConfirm: String? = null, cancel: String? = null, messageRow: MonarchMessageRowLabels = MonarchMessageRowLabels())

options.name: comments
options.description: The comments, oldest first. The first starts the thread; the rest are replies. Each has an id, author, body, creation time in epoch milliseconds, an optional avatar Painter and canDelete.

options.name: quote
options.description: The passage the thread is about, shown above it in the muted color with a bar along the start edge.

options.name: resolved
options.description: A Resolved badge, the subtle fill, Reopen instead of Resolve, and a hint instead of the reply field.

options.name: visibleReplies
options.description: The latest replies shown before older ones fold behind Show N earlier replies. Folding never hides a single reply.

options.name: now
options.description: Fixes now for the relative times. Without it the times follow the clock.

options.name: replyState
options.description: The reply text. Hoist it to keep a draft.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, including the comments' MonarchMessageRowLabels.

options.name: onResolvedChange
options.description: Resolves (true) or reopens (false); shows the Resolve or Reopen button, which shows progress while it runs. Throw to report a failure.

options.name: onReply
options.description: Posts the trimmed reply; shows the reply field. The field clears when it returns and keeps the text when it throws.

options.name: onDeleteComment
options.description: Deletes the comment with this id after a confirmation dialog; offered on comments with canDelete, by long press and as a TalkBack action.

options.name: resolveIcon
options.description: The icon before Resolve, a MonarchIcon with a null description. Text only without it.

states.name: open
states.description: The comments, Resolve when onResolvedChange is given, and the reply field when onReply is given.

states.name: folded
states.description: With more replies than visibleReplies plus one, the starting comment, a Show N earlier replies button and the latest replies. The button reveals all and moves focus to the first revealed reply.

states.name: resolving
states.description: The Resolve or Reopen button shows a progress indicator until onResolvedChange returns.

states.name: sending
states.description: The composer's send button shows Sending… until onReply returns; the text clears on success.

states.name: resolved
states.description: The subtle fill, a success Resolved badge, Reopen, and This thread is resolved. Reopen it to reply. instead of the reply field.

states.name: failed
states.description: That didn't work. Try again. in the strong danger color under the thread; a failed reply keeps its text.

states.name: confirming delete
states.description: A Material 3 AlertDialog: Delete this comment?, a danger Delete comment button and Cancel.

states.name: empty
states.description: With no comments, only the reply field (when onReply is given); the thread has no TalkBack name.

appearance: No fill while open and the subtle background role when resolved. The quote is muted text beside a strong border bar; the Resolved badge uses the success subtle roles; a failure uses the strong danger text role; comments and the reply field keep the MonarchMessageRow and MonarchMessageComposer roles. The same roles adapt to dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web's CommentThread shows a delete icon button on each deletable comment and a hint about Enter and Shift+Enter; on Android, Delete is in the comment's long-press menu and a TalkBack action (MonarchMessageRow's actions), and the on-screen keyboard's Enter adds a line while the send button sends (MonarchMessageComposer's behavior), so there is no keyboard hint. The web returns promises from its callbacks; Android takes suspending functions and treats a thrown exception as the failure. A resolved thread on the web is muted with opacity; Monarch never dims with alpha, so Android uses the subtle background and a Resolved badge, which also says the state in text. The web's success notices are visually hidden; on Android the same live region shows them as a muted caption. The thread is a Column, not a LazyColumn, so it can sit in a scrolling screen or sheet; folding keeps it short. Comment bodies are plain strings, where the web accepts any React node. iOS has no entry for this id yet.
accessibility: The thread is a traversal group named Thread started by <first author>.
The quote is one element read as Quoted text: <quote>.
Each comment is a MonarchMessageRow: author, full date and body are one element.
Delete comment is a TalkBack custom action and a long-press menu item on comments with canDelete, and asks for confirmation in a dialog.
Resolve, Reopen, Show N earlier replies and Send reply are buttons with a 48dp touch target.
Resolved is written as a badge, not shown by color alone.
Success (Reply sent, Thread resolved, Thread reopened) and failure are written in a polite live region that is always present, so changes are announced.
Show N earlier replies moves focus to the first revealed reply.
The reply field is named Reply for TalkBack.
edgeCases: Folding never hides a single reply: with visibleReplies 3, four replies are all shown and five fold two.
With no comments the thread has no TalkBack name and shows only the reply field.
onReply receives the trimmed text; an empty or blank field cannot be sent.
Without now, the relative times refresh every minute while on screen.
A second tap on Resolve while it is saving is ignored.

examples.title: Open thread with a quote
examples.template:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchCommentThread(
    comments = comments,
    quote = {{quote}},
    resolved = resolved,
    now = {{now|millis}},
    onResolvedChange = { resolved = it /* Save on the server; throw on failure. */ },
    onReply = { body ->
        comments += MonarchCommentThreadComment("c${comments.size + 1}", "Lee Park", body, System.currentTimeMillis(), canDelete = true)
    },
    onDeleteComment = { id -> comments.removeAll { it.id == id } },
)
examples.code:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchCommentThread(
    comments = comments,
    quote = "Billed monthly, cancel any time.",
    resolved = resolved,
    now = 1_773_144_000_000L,
    onResolvedChange = { resolved = it /* Save on the server; throw on failure. */ },
    onReply = { body ->
        comments += MonarchCommentThreadComment("c${comments.size + 1}", "Lee Park", body, System.currentTimeMillis(), canDelete = true)
    },
    onDeleteComment = { id -> comments.removeAll { it.id == id } },
)
